correctness.rationale: Conditional on an isotropic normal, inner endpoint projections are independent arcsine; outer chord offset is an independent arcsine law with radius R. Since the inner chord lies in the outer disk, offset containment is equivalent to actual segment crossing. Tonelli gives the explicit kernel, the binomial expansion gives strictly positive coefficients, and elementary integrals supply the first coefficients and p(1)=1/3. Endpoint G(x)~2sqrt(2(1-x))/pi yields cn=1/(pi²n²)+O(n^-5/2), and the log-series Abelian calculation yields the sharp cusp; the global two-sided constants follow by coefficient positivity. Independent quadratures and Monte Carlo were executed, but proofs of infinite statements are analytical.
